5544455.name: Chabad Nicaragua
5544455.note: Its own site: 'נוסד על ידי הרב דוד עטר והרבנית חני עטר בשנת 2012' (founded by Rabbi David Atar and Rebbetzin Chani Atar in 2012; chabadnicaragua.com/about). Agreeing: 'Until six and a half years ago, the place lacked a Chabad presence' (Beis Moshiach via ChabadInfo, 17 July 2018, https://chabadinfo.com/magazine/shliach-shares-nicaragua-dangers/, when the Attars had to close and leave in the unrest). The Atars ran it in April 2015 (Tico Times, https://ticotimes.net/?p=61583, a corner building near the beach); Nicaragua's first mikvah 2016. Its chabad.org listing was remade in mid-2022.

extra-panama-beth-el.name: Beth El Synagogue
extra-panama-beth-el.note: 'In 5746, the Ashkenazi Jewish community in Panama City (affiliated with the Beth E-l synagogue) sent a request to the Rebbe's office ... that they were looking for a new Rav'; Rabbi Hodakov sent Rabbi Zushe Wilhelm 'not only as a Rav of the community but also as the Shliach of the Rebbe'; he opened a Gan Israel day camp on arriving, made the shul Orthodox with a mechitzah, and 'The Wilhelms spent three successful years' until the 1988 crisis (COLlive, 14 Mar 2022, from Mrs. Wilhelm and her children). 'Thirty-five years ago, Rabbi Zushe Wilhelm a'h went on shlichus to Panama and was active in the Beit El shul' (ChabadInfo, 19 Dec 2022). Medium: 5746 is Oct 1985 to Sept 1986. Then Rabbi Aron (Ari) Laine, head shliach and Chief Ashkenazi Rabbi: 'In 1994, I made my way to Panama, where the Ashkenazi community was on the lookout for a rabbi' (interview, March 2025, https://blogs.timesofisrael.com/exploring-the-jewish-community-in-panama-an-interview-with-rabbi-aaron-laine/). Beth El's community dates from 1944; its Paitilla campus is from 2014, before that Obarrio.

earlier.where: the Beth El synagogue's building in Obarrio, Panama City, before its Paitilla campus (2014)

people.name: Rabbi Zushe Wilhelm
people.note: Rav of Beth El and the Rebbe's shliach (5746); his wife Esther Wilhelm
